rows.grounds: fused compound ending in janmā; internal sandhi not split

items.question: Which named being follows ṛṣabha in the ordered list of sixteen bhūteśas?
premises: The verse continues an ordered list of bhūteśas.
asaṃbhavothanūjanmā and ekadaṃṣṭraḥ are named in sequence.
tataḥ paraḥ marks the next supreme one.
items.inference: The verse adds asaṃbhavothanūjanmā and ekadaṃṣṭraḥ, then points to the next supreme being.
uncertainties: The internal segmentation of asaṃbhavothanūjanmā remains uncertain.
items.plain_english: Asaṃbhavothanūjanmā, Ekadaṃṣṭra, then the next supreme.
